data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Create tests/hooks/test-mode-detect.sh — behavioral tests that assert mode-detect.sh stdout is exactly 'ci-pr' or 'local' given specific git remote and config conditions. Tests must FAIL RED when plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh does not exist.

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- DD1: Integration test with mocked git remote returning empty asserts banner is 'MODE: local — per-story PR mechanisms inactive'
- DD2: Integration test with remote present and ci-pr config asserts banner is 'MODE: ci-pr'
- DD3: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic (test file exists and covers all 4 cases)

## Test Approach

Given (case 1 — local mode): enforcement.strategy=ci, merge.strategy=pr, but git remote returns empty
When: mode-detect.sh runs
Then: stdout == 'local'

Given (case 2 — ci-pr mode): enforcement.strategy=ci, merge.strategy=pr, git remote returns 'https://github.com/org/repo'
When: mode-detect.sh runs
Then: stdout == 'ci-pr'

Given (case 3 — non-ci): enforcement.strategy=local, merge.strategy=pr, remote present
When: mode-detect.sh runs
Then: stdout == 'local'

Given (case 4 — non-pr): enforcement.strategy=ci, merge.strategy=direct, remote present
When: mode-detect.sh runs
Then: stdout == 'local'

## File Impact

### Files to Create
- tests/hooks/test-mode-detect.sh

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Test file exists at tests/hooks/test-mode-detect.sh and is executable
- [ ] Test FAILS RED (exit 1) when plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh is absent
- [ ] Test uses source tests/lib/assert.sh helpers
- [ ] Test mocks dso-config.conf reads via temp config files (no real config mutation)
- [ ] Test mocks git remote get-url via PATH-prepended stub or function override
- [ ] All 4 test cases present (empty remote, ci-pr, non-ci, non-pr)
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_mode_detect_ci_pr] for plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh
  Verify: grep 'test_mode_detect_ci_pr' /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/worktree-20260511-110342/.test-index
- [ ] ShellCheck passes on test file

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
